title: ConductorDispositions
description: Per-finding outcomes recorded by the main agent after reconciling the two reviewer reports and applying fixes or accepting risk. One file per panel (one panel per round).

round.description: 1-indexed round number within the review cycle.

findings_path.description: Absolute path to the panel dir (~/.orchestra/panels/<panel-id>/) whose two reviewer reports this disposition covers.

finding_id.description: Stable id the main agent assigns to each distinct finding while reconciling the two reviewer reports (e.g. F001).

outcome.description: fixed = code change applied this round. acknowledged = real finding accepted as unrelated/out-of-scope for this change. false_positive = main agent verified the finding does not apply (cite the contradicting code in reason).

reason.description: Why this outcome. For acknowledged, must justify why the finding is unrelated/out-of-scope (e.g., 'pre-existing issue outside this change, tracked in NA-1071'). For false_positive, must cite the specific code that contradicts the finding. For fixed, a one-line summary of the change is sufficient.

fix_files.description: For outcome=fixed, the repo-relative paths touched. Optional but recommended for audit.
